chalisa.do1: Viṣṇu, hear your servant's prayer with attention. That I may tell something of your glory, teach me and grant me knowledge.
chalisa.cau1: Salutation to you, Lord Viṣṇu, slayer of Khara, destroyer of hardship, who move freely through all the world. ॥1॥
chalisa.cau2: Your power in the world is mighty; your light is spreading through the three worlds. ॥2॥
chalisa.cau3: Your form is beautiful and your face charming; your nature is simple and your figure enchanting. ॥3॥
chalisa.cau4: The yellow garment on your body looks most beautiful; the vaijayantī garland charms the mind. ॥4॥
chalisa.cau5: Conch, discus and mace shine in your hands; at the sight of them the hosts of daityas and asuras flee. ॥5॥
chalisa.cau6: Before truth and dharma, pride and greed cannot roar; desire, anger, pride and greed find no place in you. ॥6॥
chalisa.cau7: You delight the hearts of saints, devotees and the good, and destroy the hosts of dānavas, asuras and the wicked. ॥7॥
chalisa.cau8: Bringing forth happiness, you break all hardship; wiping out their faults, you make people good. ॥8॥
chalisa.cau9: Cutting away sin, you ferry beings across the ocean of worldly existence; destroying hardship, you rescue your devotees. ॥9॥
chalisa.cau10: Lord, you take on many forms, only for the sake of devotion. ॥10॥
chalisa.cau11: The earth, become a cow, called out to you; then you took the form of Śrī Rāma. ॥11॥
chalisa.cau12: Lifting the earth's burden, you slew the demon hosts and destroyed Rāvaṇa and the others. ॥12॥
chalisa.cau13: You took the form of the boar Varāha and struck down Hiraṇyākṣa. ॥13॥
chalisa.cau14: Taking the body of a fish, you set the ocean in order, and had the fourteen jewels brought out. ॥14॥
chalisa.cau15: Seeing the nectar, the demons raised a quarrel; then you showed yourself in the form of Mohinī. ॥15॥
chalisa.cau16: You gave the gods the nectar to drink and beguiled the demons with your beauty. ॥16॥
chalisa.cau17: Taking the form of the tortoise Kūrma, you had the ocean churned, and at once lifted Mount Mandara. ॥17॥
chalisa.cau18: You freed Śiva from the snare and showed Bhasmāsura your form. ॥18॥
chalisa.cau19: When a demon sank the Vedas, you devised a means and had them sought out. ॥19॥
chalisa.cau20: Becoming an enchantress, you made the wicked one dance, and had him burn himself to ashes with his own hand. ॥20॥
chalisa.cau21: The demon Jalandhara was exceedingly mighty; he made war on Śiva. ॥21॥
chalisa.cau22: Śiva tried every means and still was defeated; then the wicked one went and deceived Satī. ॥22॥
chalisa.cau23: Śiva's queen called you to mind and told you the whole tale of her trouble. ॥23॥
chalisa.cau24: Then you became a wise lord of sages, and Vṛndā lost all awareness of herself. ॥24॥
chalisa.cau25: On seeing three wicked demons, Vṛndā came and clung to you. ॥25॥
chalisa.cau26: With that touch her dharma was held to be broken, and Śiva struck the wicked demon in the heart and slew him. ॥26॥
chalisa.cau27: You saved Dhruva and Prahlāda, and slew Hiraṇyakaśipu and the other wicked ones. ॥27॥
chalisa.cau28: You delivered the courtesan and Ajāmila, and carried many devotees across the ocean of worldly existence. ॥28॥
chalisa.cau29: Take away all our anguish; have mercy, Hari, creator of all. ॥29॥
chalisa.cau30: May I myself behold you, friend of the lowly, benefactor of your devotees. ॥30॥
chalisa.cau31: Your servant longs for the sight of you; Madhusūdana, show your mercy. ॥31॥
chalisa.cau32: I do not know the proper japa and worship, nor how sacrifice and praise may be accepted. ॥32॥
chalisa.cau33: Good conduct, compassion, contentment and the marks of virtue, and the rare knowledge of vows: none of these is known to me. ॥33॥
chalisa.cau34: How shall I worship you? Seeing my own evil mind, I am in terrible pain. ॥34॥
chalisa.cau35: How shall I bow to you, by what way remember you, and in what manner offer myself to you? ॥35॥
chalisa.cau36: Gods and sages ever serve you, and having reached the supreme state they live in joy. ॥36॥
chalisa.cau37: You are ever the helper of the humble and the suffering; knowing me for your own, take me as yours. ॥37॥
chalisa.cau38: Destroy sin, fault and anguish; set me free from the bonds of worldly existence. ॥38॥
chalisa.cau39: Grant sons and wealth and bring forth happiness; make me the servant of your feet. ॥39॥
chalisa.cau40: The Veda ever proclaims this prayer; whoever reads or hears it finds happiness. ॥40॥
